source_quality_flags: The official Zenodo API identifies the reuse licence as odc-odbl; external displays may render the same ODbL family with a different label.
The Zenodo description calls the TEM images raw, but that wording does not prove detector-native intensity preservation for every member.
The deposit combines SEM/TKD and TEM/SAED/EDS materials; folder identity must be preserved and files must not be joined by row order.
As-deposited and He-irradiated conditions are scientifically distinct and must not be pooled without specimen-level lineage.
The source is a W-Ta-Cr-V refractory high-entropy alloy and is not an in-domain cobalt-oxide validation cohort.
A repository licence permits reuse but does not establish calibration, acquisition independence or analyzer-development non-use.
